definitions_hook.$comment: §49. A genuine textual hook, checked in both directions rather than used only where it helps.
definitions_hook.clause: **Globalping** the Globalping platform further described on the Website;
definitions_hook.effect: the Terms incorporate the Website's description of the platform by reference
definitions_hook.what_the_website_says: Monitor, debug and benchmark your internet infrastructure from a globally distributed network of probes.
definitions_hook.why_this_matters: the hook was followed looking for a widening and the incorporated description repeats the same narrowing. That is a stronger finding than not having looked.

reservation_of_rights.$comment: §19. Recorded with its scope rather than as a general prohibition.
reservation_of_rights.clause: We reserve all rights that are not expressly granted to you under these Terms or by law, including all rights in relation to the look and feel of the Website and Globalping.
reservation_of_rights.how_it_is_weighed: it sits in a proprietary-rights section and is about intellectual property in the Website and platform. It is not a use-purpose prohibition, and it is also not nothing: it means an absence of an express grant is not itself a grant.
